A national digital-government agency — a Public Sector & Government engagement delivered by a blended Dataq Software team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
Permits and benefit files paper-shaped; backlogs measured in months.
AI proposals blocked by accountability gaps; no oversight framework. Agency data islands prevented tell-us-once services.

Casework agents assemble evidence with officer-approval gates; every AI-assisted decision carries transparency notices, human oversight and Compass-generated conformity documentation mapped to the EU AI Act; the interagency exchange (consent-aware, event-driven) enabled tell-us-once across four agencies.
What the success is actually made of

items: the models and retrieval systems were evaluated before anyone trusted them — grounded answers, cited sources, measured quality.
the agents ran inside a policy envelope with replay, so autonomy never outran the evidence.
the data spine was certified once and reused everywhere, which is why the numbers held up under audit.
